problems.title: Binary division
problems.question: Evaluate 10100₂÷101₂ and give the result in binary.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: 10100₂=20 and 101₂=5 in decimal.
steps: Their quotient is 4, whose binary for m is 100₂.

problems.title: Order three radicals
problems.question: Order a=2√10, b=√32, c=√225/2.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: All are positive, so compare squares:a²=40, b²=32, c²=225/4=56.25.
steps: Thus b<a<c.

problems.title: A radical conjugate product
problems.question: Evaluate(√18+√45)√((√2−√5)²).
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
steps: The product is 3(5−2)=9.

problems.title: Altitude times hypotenuse
problems.question: In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse times the hypotenuse is √18 times one leg. Find the other leg.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Equating triangle areas gives hc=ab.
steps: If hc=√18·a, then ab=√18·a. Cancel the positive leg a to get b=√18=3√2.

problems.title: Smallest-angle sine
problems.question: A triangle has sides 3,2,√5. Find the sine of its smallest angle.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: 2²+(√5)²=3², so it is right with hypotenuse3.
steps: The smallest angle is opposite side 2, so its sine is 2/3.

problems.title: Vieta plus a real-root check
problems.question: x²+3bx+b²+2=0 has 2 real roots whose sum plus product is 0. Find the listed b.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
steps: At b=1, the discriminant9−12=−3 gives no real roots. At b=2, the discriminant36−24=12>0.

problems.title: Cancel negative prime powers
problems.question: Evaluate 24⁻⁸·6⁻¹²/(18⁻¹⁰·8⁻¹²).
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: The net power of 2 is −24−12+10+36=10. The net power of 3 is −8−12+20=0.
steps: Thus the value is 2¹⁰=4⁵=1024.

problems.title: A quadratic in a square root
problems.question: Find the sum of roots of 4x−1=3(2√x−1).
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
steps: The u-values1/2,1 give x=1/4,1. Their sum is 5/4.

problems.title: Squared tangent lengths
problems.question: Circle centres are 10 apart and radii are 2,6. Find external-tangent length squared:internal-tangent length squared.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
steps: The ratio84:36 reduces to 7:3.

problems.title: A half-angle tangent in a rhombus
problems.question: A rhombus has side 10, height 8, and acute angle A. Find tan(A/2).
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: sin A=8/10=4/5; since A is acute, cos A=3/5.

problems.title: Integers between two radical magnitudes
problems.question: Count integers satisfying|x|>√199 and|x|<√2025.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
steps: The allowed magnitudes are 15 through44:30 values. Each gives a positive and negative integer, total60.

problems.title: A cubic root sum from a system
problems.question: The system y=x², x−y=−6 has 2 solution pairs. Find x₁y₁+x₂y₂.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Substitute to get x²−x−6=(x−3)(x+2)=0.
steps: The pairs are(3,9),(−2,4). The requested sum is 27−8=19.

problems.title: Factor an absolute-value equation
problems.question: Find the product of distinct roots of|x−1|=|x²−3x+2|.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Factor the right side as|x−1||x−2|.
steps: Either x=1, or after cancelling the nonzero factor,|x−2|=1. This gives x=1 or 3, so the distinct root set is{1,3}.
Their product is 3.

problems.title: Altitude four times the inradius
problems.question: An isosceles triangle’s base altitude h is 4 times its inradius. Find the base-angle cosine.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Let half-base q and leg s. Area=qh, semiperimeter=q+s, so r=qh/(q+s).
steps: The condition h/r=4 gives(q+s)/q=4, so s=3q. The base-angle cosine is q/s=1/3.

problems.title: Inside and outside secant lengths
problems.question: An external point is 7 from a circle centre, radius 5. A secant’s outside part is 2 shorter than its inside part. Find the inside length.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Let inside length t, outside t−2. Power gives(t−2)(2t−2)=7²−5²=24.
steps: This reduces to(t−5)(t+2)=0. The positive feasible value is t=5.

problems.title: Boat speed in still water
problems.question: A boat travels24 km downstream and 8 km upstream in4h. Current speed4 km/h. Find still-water speed.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Let v>4. Time equation:24/(v+4)+8/(v−4)=4.
steps: Multiplying gives 32v−64=4v²−64, so 4v(v−8)=0. Only v=8 satisfies v>4.

problems.title: A complex radical fraction
problems.question: Simplify{[x/(x−√2)−√2/(x+√2)] /[(x²+2)/(x²+x√2)]} ÷(√2/x−1)⁻¹.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: The bracketed numerator is(x²+2)/(x²−2). Dividing by(x²+2)/[x(x+√2)] gives x/(x−√2).
steps: Dividing by the reciprocal multiplies by √2/x−1=(√2−x)/x. The final result is −1.
problems.note: The original expression excludes x=0,±√2; these exclusions remain after simplification.

problems.title: Transform the roots before using Vieta
problems.question: The equation a(2x/(x+1))²+b(2x/(x+1))+c=0 has roots 1,−2. Find(c+b)/a.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Under t=2x/(x+1), the given roots map to t=1,4. Thus b/a=−5, c/a=4.
steps: Therefore(c+b)/a=4−5=−1.

problems.title: A ray through one quarter of an altitude
problems.question: In isosceles ABC, AB=BC, BH is the base altitude. A ray from A meets BH at M and BC at N, with BM:MH=3:1. Find BN:NC.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
steps: Their intersection has x=3/5, y=2h/5. This is 3/5 of the way from B to C, so BN:NC=3:2.

problems.title: Side difference across a120° angle
problems.question: A side 7 is opposite120°. The other sides sum 8. Find their absolute difference.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Cosine rule:49=a²+b²+ab=(a+b)²−ab=64−ab.
steps: Hence ab=15. Then(a−b)²=(a+b)²−4ab=64−60=4, so|a−b|=2.

problems.title: A biquadratic centred at2
problems.question: Find the sum of real roots of(x−2)²(x²−4x)+3=0.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Let t=(x−2)²≥0. Since x²−4x=t−4, the equation is(t−1)(t−3)=0.
steps: The 4 roots are 2±1 and 2±√3. Each symmetric pair sums4, total8.

problems.title: Minimize the root-square sum
problems.question: For which a is the sum of squares of roots of x²−(a−1)x−a²−a=0 least?
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Root sum=a−1, product=−a²−a. Thus squared sum=(a−1)²+2a²+2a=3a²+1.
steps: The minimum occurs at a=0. The discriminant5a²+2a+1 is positive for every a, so no real-root restriction invalidates it.

problems.title: A denominator excludes the possible roots
problems.question: For which a has(x²+(a+2)x+2a)/√(x−1)=0 no roots?
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: The numerator is(x+2)(x+a), while the denominator requires x>1.
steps: Root−2 is always excluded. The other root −a is allowed exactly when a<−1. Thus there are no roots for a≥−1.

problems.title: Recover a side from three medians
problems.question: A triangle’s medians have lengths 9,12,15. Find its largest side.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: The side opposite median m_a satisfies a²=(4/9)(2m_b²+2m_c²−m_a²). The largest side corresponds to the smallest median9.

problems.title: Circumradius using two tangent circles
problems.question: Intersecting circles have radii√8,√18 and a common external tangent touching at A, C. B is a circle intersection. Find the circumradius of ABC.
problems.idea: Simplify exactly, and keep root, sign, and domain conditions throughout.
formulas: Put tangent AC on y=0 and B at height h. The circle equations give AB²=2R₁|h| and BC²=2R₂|h|.
steps: Using circumradius=AB·BC/(2·altitude from B) gives √(R₁R₂).
Here R₁R₂=√(8·18)=12, so the circumradius is √12=2√3.
